title.narrative: Support to HNEC Womens Support Unit

description.narrative: In 2021, PEPOL supported the HNEC Womens Support Unit to develop an annual work plan, gather genderdisaggregated data, conduct call centre surveys and host webinars. In partnership with UN Women, 257 women and youth were trained in campaign planning and management, strategic messaging, leadership and pandemic precautions. PEPOL also facilitated HNEC Womens Support Unit participation in the international conference of the Network of Women in Electoral Organizations. In early 2022, the project secured genderinclusivity earmarked funding and has been initiated informationgathering, analysis and strategic planning as a first step in implementing comprehensive support to the Womens Support Unit. A collaboration between the UNDP Election Project and UN Women launched a yearlong training programme for young women from Libya, called the Raidat Programme, for 30 participants in October 2023. A similar programme was launched in October 2024 for 35 participantsWomen have not only been a key audience but have also served as vital collaborators with the HNEC. Women Ambassadors led outreach efforts within their communities, while regional conferences brought together female parliamentarians from neighboring and other African countries. Additionally, civil society organizations mobilized their networks to encourage women to register and vote in the municipal elections held on 16 November 2024.

description.narrative: Support and advocacy for strengthening of the unit

comment.narrative: Turnout in 2012 GNC elections 62 female turnout 38 2014 CDA elections 46 female turnout 33.4 2014 HoR elections 41 female turnout 31

By early 2022 the project had secured earmarked funding to ensure support to the HNEC Womens Support Unit had secured commitment of relevant Commissioners to support genderinclusivity activities had initiated recruitment of specialised advisors and had initiated baseline studies and analyses.
